_comment: Copy to configs/api_keys.json (git-ignored). Create keys with: python -m myllm.adab.api new-key --name "…" --plan school. Only SHA-256 hashes go here; the key itself is shown once to the customer. Plans: trial (20/min, 2000/month), school (60/min, 30000/month), pro (300/min, 500000/month); rate_per_minute / monthly_quota may be overridden per key.
